text:
alex: quick heads up — external assessment booked for Thu 15:00 UTC. Need to finalize timeboxed RBAC, KMS access pattern, and an evidence preservation plan. who can own the assessor access window?

maria: I can own the access window. plan: ephemeral role with 6h max, pre-created presigned urls for evidence upload, and audit-event sampling enabled for the duration. cc @ops-oncall for role creation. :white_check_mark:

sam: for KMS — do assessors need raw decrypt access? i'd prefer a read-only KMS proxy that hands back ciphertext only, and we provide decrypted blobs via a signed process. avoids exposing plaintext keys.

alex: agree with sam. goal: no plaintext key material outside our services. we can create a KMS-enforced proxy service which accepts GetObject requests and returns blobs after internal ACL check. calls logged.

jonah: Assessor question — what exact evidence sink and retention? do they need continuous access to logs or just snapshots?

maria: snapshots + scoped log exports. plan: 1) pre-export CloudTrail and app logs for last 30 days to s3://redwood-pt-evidence/<engagement-id>/snapshots/ 2) enable CloudTrail insight + event selectors during window for more granular events. retention: 90 days for assessment artifacts.

assessor-bot: assessor intake: please provide presigned PUT URLs for object uploads, and a read-only listing role. recommended max size 200MB per artifact.\n

ops-oncall: i will create the ephemeral role `pt_assessor_2026_03` with trust policy -> sts:AssumeRole with ExternalId and max session 6h. will attach a permissions boundary that prevents kms:Decrypt. i'll also add a managed policy that allows s3:PutObject to the evidence prefix and s3:ListBucket for the snapshot prefix. ETA 2h.

alex: perfect. maria — can you draft the RBAC manifest + pre-signed URL generator script? keep TTL 24h for the presigned urls used to upload evidence during intake.

maria: putting draft below, feedback welcome:
```yaml
# ephemeral role policy snippet
Statement:
  - Effect: Allow
    Action:
      - s3:PutObject
      - s3:ListBucket
    Resource:
      - arn:aws:s3:::redwood-pt-evidence/ENG-2026-030/*
  - Effect: Deny
    Action:
      - kms:Decrypt
    Resource: '*'
```

sam: small note — we need audit-event-sampling turned on for inference runtime (kv-cache ops) too. add `redwood-inference-runtime` logs to the export list, otherwise certain cached attacks won't show.

maria: added runtime logs to the export checklist. also adding instructions for evidence chain-of-custody: record who generated presigned URL, who uploaded, and object checksum.

alex: remediation tracking — let's use the tracker spreadsheet (internal) named "ENG-SEC PT Tracker" and tag items with severity + owner. retest window: propose 7 business days after findings delivered. if quick patches, we can schedule an accelerated retest slot within 48-72h.

jonah: for retest provisioning — ops, can you create a repeatable playbook so we can repro the exact ephemeral role and exports? want deterministic handoff so assessors retest doesn't get blocked by config drift.

ops-oncall: will capture Terraform snippet and a one-click runbook. Terraform will include: IAM role, s3 bucket policy for prefix, cloudtrail event selector, and a kms-policy that denies decrypt for the role. will put it in the runbooks repo and link in the tracker. ETA EOD.

maria: next steps checklist: 1) ops creates role + policies 2) ops generates presigned URL generator lambda 3) sam and alex review KMS proxy approach and approve no-decrypt pattern 4) maria prepares snapshot exports and runbook 5) schedule retest slots in tracker. i'll post a final signoff message when done. :rocket:

alex: thanks — ping me when ops has the role so we can run a quick smoke test (attempt assume + put artifact + verify CloudTrail entry).

ops-oncall: role created and pushed to staging terraform: `pt_assessor_2026_03`. test window open for smoke testing now. replies here with any failures.

alex: did a quick smoke: assume ok, s3 put ok, CloudTrail event present, KMS decrypt blocked as expected. :thumbsup:

maria: closing this intake — i've updated the tracker with links to terraform, runbook, and evidence prefix. retest window options posted. thanks all.
